title: Basilan RTC judge killed in Zamboanga City ambush

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — A regional trial court judge based in Isabela City, Basilan, was killed in an ambush by still unidentified gunmen early Thursday morning in Zamboanga City, the Zamboanga City Police Office (ZCPO) confirmed. The victim was identified as Judge Joseph Wee Sit, presiding judge of the Regional Trial Court (RTC) Branch 2 in Isabela City. Initial police reports said Sit was inside his vehicle while traveling along Tumaga-Putik Road in Barangay Tumaga at around 5:25 a.m. when the assailants opened fire.
